input:
Meeting: Q2 Roadmap Review (March 4, 2026)
Attendees: Sarah (PM), Tom (Eng), Priya (Eng), Marcus (Design), Jen (Sales)

Sarah opened by recapping the Q1 deliverables. The auth refactor shipped on Feb
expected: Analytics dashboard ships GA in week 1 of April (Tom owns the GA checklist).
Mobile parity is scoped to read-only views in Q2; full parity slips to Q3 because of platform team capacity.
Data team is at 90% allocation through April; no new work until May; platform team has one open req with target mid-April start.
response:
- Decisioned to launch analytics dashboard GA in April week 1, with a reduced mobile parity goal starting Q2.
- Blocked on full mobile parity rollout due to platform team capacity constraints; read-only views planned for Q2, full parity for Q3.
- Next steps: Tom drafts GA checklist by Mar 8, Marcus scopes read-only feature by Mar 11, Sarah revises and shares OKRs by Mar 5.
